name: fsgg
description: FS-GG operator route definitions. Carries the routed worker and critic subagent definitions the board-driver skills dispatch, so a clean checkout can request an exact <runtime, model, effort> route without a hand-authored agent file.

plugins.name: fsgg-routes
plugins.description: The four routed subagent definitions the FS-GG board-driver skills dispatch: fsgg-worker-normal, fsgg-worker-best, fsgg-critic-normal, fsgg-critic-best. Their frontmatter carries model and effort verbatim, which is why the routes ship as a plugin rather than as prose.
